verdict.rationale: OpenHands docs mention a binary 'auto-approve all actions (use with caution)' toggle in CLI mode, implying manual confirmation is the default and can be disabled, but there is no evidence of multiple graduated autonomy tiers (e.g., read-only, suggest-only, scoped auto-approval by action type) that an engineering-lead could configure. Missing for 10: documented tiered/graduated permission levels, per-action-type approval rules, and any UI/API to set differentiated autonomy tiers for teams.
